display.purpose: Marketing hero headlines. Tight tracking, near-overlapping leading.

headline.purpose: Section openings on marketing pages, page titles in product.

title.purpose: Card titles, panel headers, modal titles.

body.purpose: Default reading text. Capped at 65–75ch on prose surfaces.

body-lg.purpose: Hero supporting copy and marketing introductions.

label.purpose: Uppercase eyebrows, section markers, status indicators. The system's whisper.

mono.purpose: Tool calls, latencies, IDs, code. What the system reports, not what it says.

shadows.name: state-lift
shadows.purpose: Hover state on primary CTAs and interactive cards.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus on inputs, buttons, links.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Default state transitions. Heavy decelerating settle.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Reserved for the rare entrance moments where choreography is earned.

motion.name: duration-normal
motion.purpose: State changes that need to be felt. The product default.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The accent CTA. Full-pill, bold, Operator Emerald. Used for the single most important action on a surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.72 0.17 162); color: oklch(0.99 0.002 285); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9375rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.65 0.16 162); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0.18 0.005 285 / 0.05), 0 4px 12px oklch(0.18 0.005 285 / 0.06); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.72 0.17 162 / 0.20); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: oklch(0.58 0.15 162); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary CTA on marketing surfaces. Hairline border, transparent background, ink text.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: oklch(0.18 0.005 285); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9375rem; padding: 12px 24px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.91 0.004 285); border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.96 0.003 285); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.72 0.17 162 / 0.20); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Tertiary action. No border, no background until hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: oklch(0.18 0.005 285); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9375rem; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.96 0.003 285); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.72 0.17 162 / 0.20); }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Small full-pill label. Default uses surface-elevated; tinted variants per state.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: oklch(0.96 0.003 285); color: oklch(0.40 0.005 285); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; }

components.name: Eyebrow
components.description: Uppercase section marker. Whisper-quiet by design.

components.name: Input
components.description: Default text input. 16px radius, hairline border, Operator Emerald focus.
components.css: .ds-input { background: oklch(0.99 0.002 285); color: oklch(0.18 0.005 285); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.91 0.004 285); border-radius: 16px; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.65 0.005 285); font-weight: 400; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: oklch(0.72 0.17 162); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.72 0.17 162 / 0.20); }

narrative.overview: Brainiac runs two surfaces inside one product. The Dashboard is spatial: an infinite canvas where users pan, zoom, place, and connect. The Agency is structured: rows, totals, time, execution. The visual system has to speak both dialects without ever sounding like two products bolted together. One typographic voice, one quiet color discipline, one component vocabulary; the layout grammar shifts between registers. The system rejects the dominant aesthetic of its category. No purple-blue gradient heroes, no animated orbs, no gradient text, no glassmorphism, no AI-tool neon. The agent is a tool, not a personality. The canvas is the product. UI chrome serves the work and gets out of the way the moment a user is thinking. Calm, focused, plain-spoken. Trust earned through restraint, not flash. The marketing register is allowed editorial confidence; the product register is allowed density. Same family, same components, different rhythm.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained color: tinted neutrals, one accent (Operator Emerald) used on ≤10% of any product surface.
Typographic hierarchy carries the system. IBM Plex Sans across roles, IBM Plex Mono for tool traces and metric values.
Flat by default. Hairlines (1px) separate content; shadows appear only as a response to state.
Generous radii on containers (32px cards, full pills on buttons and badges) keep the system feeling crafted, not clinical.
Two registers, one component vocabulary. A button looks the same on the landing page and inside the canvas toolbar.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Operator Emerald is used on ≤10% of any given screen. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: No #000 and no #fff raw. Every neutral is zinc-tinted (chroma ~0.005).

rules.name: The Semantic Reuse Rule
rules.body: Success and Operator Emerald share a hue family. The product equates 'primary action' and 'successful state' by design.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Section eyebrows are rendered in Label scale at neutral-400/500. Never colored, never emerald, never bolder. They are the system's whisper.

rules.name: The Single Family Rule
rules.body: No display/serif pairing. IBM Plex Sans across the entire scale. Hierarchy comes from weight and size.

rules.name: The Mono For Truth Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Mono is reserved for things the system reports, not things the system says. Latencies, IDs, paths, code. Never running prose, never headings.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Reach for hairlines or tonal layering before shadow.

rules.name: The Hairline First Rule
rules.body: Separation is hairline before tonal layering, and tonal layering before shadow. Walk the ladder.

dos: Do use Operator Emerald on primary actions, current selection, and system-status indicators only.
Do keep the accent on ≤10% of any given screen.
Do use hairlines (1px solid var(--hairline)) as the default separator.
Do render every interactive element with all seven states: default, hover, focus-visible, active, disabled, loading, error.
Do use full-pill radii for buttons and badges, generous (32px) radii for cards.
Do use IBM Plex Sans for everything that speaks; use IBM Plex Mono for everything the system reports.
Do put a quiet inline system-status indicator in the footer (marketing) or rail (product), never a floating chrome.
Do place navigation in the footer on marketing surfaces and in a standard top-bar or rail in product surfaces.
Do make tool traces selectable, plain-prose-shaped, and free of decorative badges.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: strip animation, keep opacity fades only.
donts: Don't use SaaS-cream clichés: purple/blue gradient heroes, hero-metric-with-sparkline cards, identical icon-and-heading card grids.
Don't ship AI-product slop: neon glows, gradient text, sparkle decoration, robot mascot avatars, animated orbs.
Don't apply enterprise heaviness: Salesforce/Jira density, nested tabs of nested tabs, dropdowns with 30 options.
Don't use #000 or #fff raw. Every neutral is zinc-tinted.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe.
Don't use background-clip: text with a gradient.
Don't use blur or glassmorphism as a default.
Don't wrap everything in a card. Nested cards are always wrong.
Don't orchestrate page-load entrance sequences in product surfaces.
Don't use em dashes anywhere in copy or UI text.
Don't use loading spinners where a skeleton or optimistic update would do.
Don't build a modal as a first thought.
